race.description: Ararat Rural City Council Mdn Plate
race.comment: PRAY FOR ELEGANCE (8) returns for a second campaign following a five-month spell. Started favourite at his only run to date and blew his chances by missing the kick at Geelong. Has been to the trials five times since mid-September and is looking the goods. Draws okay so looks a great chance to open the account. GENERAL BLU (2) last appeared in February when a tiring fifth over 1200m at Pakenham. That followed an outstanding debut at Geelong where he came from last only to miss in a photo over 1125m. Recent Flemington jump-out winner in slick time - looms as a serious challenger. HELLOFACURY (3) comes here off a 37-week break. Showed ability in the maiden preparation. Jump-out form recently has been sound. The Hayes stable has a promising debutant in DREAM FOR FREE (1). Betting the key.
